newsitem.title: NORWAY: Norwegian shares power ahead, hit new all-time high.
newsitem.headline: Norwegian shares power ahead, hit new all-time high.

text.p: Buyers remained active on the Oslo bourse on Tuesday and Norwegian shares continued to power ahead to hit a new all-time closing high.
Brokers said activity centred on blue chip and cyclical stocks.

Oslo's Total share index closed 0.76 percent up at 950.14 points, the first time the index had closed above the 950-point mark. The index's all-time intra-day peak was set on December 5 at 952.08 points.
Turnover was more than 25 percent up from Monday at 980 million crowns.
Shipbuilding and engineering group Kvaerner posted the most trade of the day in value terms at 187 million crowns due to the expiry of options.
The group's A stock advanced four crowns to 291 crowns while the B's finish five crowns higher at 264 crowns.
Sentiment in forestry company Norske Skog remained positive due to expectations of higher pulp and print paper prices.
Skog added seven crowns to finish at 214 crowns. The A share climed 10 crowns on Monday.
